prerequisites: successful completion of the course Computer Networks 1/ZPS1
successfully completed CCNA: Introduction to Networks with a certificate

learning_outcomes.text: Have a deeper understanding of routing principles, how finding of remote network is done and how to choose the best route under united administration entity, routing algorithms and to acquire related skills.
Successfully administer small and medium sized companies.
Have theoretical knowledge about architecture, concepts and tasks of switch and routers.
Have deep knowledge about architecture of enterprise networks, and basic management of these networks.
Be able to apply gained skills for analysis, configurations and validating basic faults and setting in enterprise networks.

assessment_rules: The condition for granting credit is the successful completion of the second semester of the CCNA e-learning course. Required success in the final theoretical test and practical is 70%. The course is completed by an examination.
